translation: <ins>Moxibustion-Ironing Method (灸熨法)</ins> This method is specifically for moxibustion-ironing the various injuries where the flesh is broken and blood comes out. Because the blood and fluids soak and moisten, one uses tree bark to separate, and only then moxibustion-irons. First place elm bark (榆樹皮) on the affected area, then pound old scallion thoroughly, mix evenly with Qi Ai Zhi Tong San (蘄艾止痛散), place it on the tree bark, moxa continuously five times, then wrap with soft silk.
